interaction.zh-Hans: 中心协调与稳定承载同时出现时，要读的是「谁定义优先级、谁保存容量、两者如何分工」，而不是把两颗星的单星段落相加。
interaction.en: When central coordination and stable capacity coexist, read how priority-setting and reserve-holding divide work rather than concatenating two star descriptions.

interaction.zh-Hans: 边界评估与探索欲求同时出现时，重点在「什么值得进入、进入到哪里要停、吸引力与后果如何协商」。
interaction.en: Read how boundary evaluation negotiates with exploration: what is worth entering, where to stop, and how attraction meets consequence.

interaction.zh-Hans: 质疑澄清与分析调整形成认知工作链：先把假设说清楚，再比较路径，并防止讨论与调整无限循环。
interaction.en: Questioning and analysis form a cognitive work chain: surface assumptions, compare paths, and prevent discussion and adjustment from becoming endless loops.

interaction.zh-Hans: 资源纪律与高压决断相遇时，重点是资源是否足以支撑明确取舍，以及执行是否因为压力而过早压缩协商。
interaction.en: When resource discipline meets high-pressure choice, ask whether capacity supports the cut and whether urgency is compressing consultation too early.

interaction.zh-Hans: 外放贡献与内向储备同时存在时，要读公开输出与内部补给怎样分工，而不是判定谁强谁弱。
interaction.en: Read how outward contribution and inward reserve divide labor rather than reducing the pair to a stronger/weaker verdict.

label.zh-Hans: 七杀 × 破军 × 贪狼互动结构
label.en: Qi Sha × Po Jun × Tan Lang interaction

interaction.zh-Hans: 决断、重组与探索共同提高变化密度；这只描述三种功能如何相互放大或制衡，不自行宣布「杀破狼格」成立。
interaction.en: Decisive action, restructuring and exploration raise change density. This describes interaction only and does not independently qualify a Sha-Po-Lang pattern.

interaction.zh-Hans: 资源留存与移动调度的组合语义必须等两颗星 standalone meaning 都通过 Human admission 后才可发布。
interaction.en: Resource retention plus mobility remains blocked until both standalone meanings receive Human admission.

interaction.zh-Hans: 当前只承认共同「劫空」语义族；不在没有新增 source authority 的情况下虚构两颗星固定且互斥的心理定义。
interaction.en: Current authority admits a shared Kong-Jie semantic family only; no rigid mutually exclusive psychology is invented without additional source authority.
